reason: The supplied OSF RPP report (https://osf.io/download/x4v53/) prints a recruited sample of 39 undergraduates (matching shipped 39) and a final complete-data analytic sample of 23 (matching blind 23) for the 2x2 repeated-measures GLM condition-by-rating-type interaction in left-amygdala extracted betas, alongside enumerated participant exclusions (10 movement >2 mm, 0 name knowledge <75%, 1 MRI contraindication, 1 non-compliance) that do not reconcile 39 to 23 and block-level collinearity omissions (1 block for n=2, 2 blocks for n=1) that are not participant exclusions. However, the supplied text is an OSF project report that notes an unknown-name regressor deviation and lacks the 2017 Psychological Science citation/DOI (10.1177/0956797617719730) or any positive nonnumeric bridge confirming that the published journal analysis retained the identical participant cohort and model.
